title: Android adds a user-selectable system-assistant slot for rival models by 2027
body: By opening the system assistant to a user-selectable model slot at WWDC - the "Search or Ask" panel that routes a query to Siri, Gemini, or ChatGPT (with Claude tested) - while pairing it with deepened App Intents and a free on-device Foundation Models framework for tool-calling and structured generation, Apple has redefined what the operating system itself owes the agent ecosystem: a swappable assistant brain, a standard way for apps to expose actions, and a no-cost local model any developer can call. Once the largest premium device base treats the assistant as a configurable slot rather than a hardwired service, the symmetric pressure on Google falls on Android, where Gemini is the default but assistant choice has historically been a fixed handoff rather than a first-class OS picker. The forward consequence is that Android promotes assistant selection to an OS-level setting that lets users route the system assistant - the Power-button/Circle-to-Search invocation and its successors - to a rival model app, not just Google's, mirroring Apple's slot. The deeper, more durable shift is on the developer side: App-Intents-style action exposure plus an on-device tool-calling framework become a pattern developers expect on every platform, so Google's App Actions / App Functions surface and on-device Gemini Nano tool-calling get repositioned as the Android-side answer to Foundation Models. Expect the assistant-slot move to be framed cautiously - couched in defaults, eligibility rules, and entitlements rather than a wide-open marketplace - because the same gateway economics that let Apple monetize two billion devices apply in reverse to Google. The falsifiable marker is an OS-level assistant-picker capability on Android, announced or shipped at Google I/O 2027 or in an Android 17-era release, that lets a user set a non-Google model app as the system assistant.

reasoning.because: WWDC made the iOS system assistant a user-selectable model slot plus a free on-device tool-call API
reasoning.given: Android keeps Gemini as a fixed default while Apple reframes the assistant as a swappable OS slot
reasoning.so_that: Google promotes assistant choice to an OS-level picker and repositions App Actions + Gemini Nano as the Android answer
reasoning.landing: Google I/O 2027 / Android 17 era: OS assistant-picker allows a non-Google model
reasoning.plain_language: After Apple let people pick which AI runs their phone's assistant, Android will likely add the same choice.

summary: Apple's WWDC user-selectable assistant slot and free on-device tool-calling pressure Google to make assistant choice an OS-level setting on Android, not a fixed Gemini handoff. The falsifiable marker is an OS-level picker for a non-Google assistant, at Google I/O 2027 or an Android 17-era release.
